prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
ai_overview_text:
No single attorney is universally "the best" for every car accident claim, as the right choice depends on the severity of your injuries, whether the case settles or goes to trial, and your personal comfort with the firm. However, several top-rated personal injury law firms in Chicago have proven track records and multi-million-dollar recoveries specifically for car and motor vehicle accidents:

Malman Law +7
Contingency Fee Structure: Most reputable car accident lawyers in Chicago work on a contingency fee (typically 25% to 40%), meaning you pay no upfront or out-of-pocket costs—they only get paid if they win or settle your case. Justia +2
Trial Readiness: Many firms settle cases quickly, but insurance companies often offer higher payouts if they know the firm is willing and experienced enough to take a case to a full jury trial. Disparti Law Group Accident & Injury Lawyers +1
You generally have 2 years from the date of the crash to file a personal injury lawsuit in Illinois.
If the claim involves a government entity or agency (such as the City of Chicago or the Chicago Transit Authority / CTA), the deadline to file a formal notice can be as short as 1 year. Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C. +2
Comparative Fault: Illinois follows a modified comparative negligence rule, meaning you can still recover compensation as long as you are 50% or less at fault (though your payout is reduced by your percentage of fault). Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C. +1
What is the approximate severity of the injuries or property damage?
Does the crash involve a special vehicle (like a commercial truck, Uber/Lyft, or CTA bus)?
